scope: Ordinary TRAIN-only representation construction and explicit OFFLINE material-capacity fitting; zero physics calls, no training, no final scientific gates.

coordinates.train: 64 independent parent normalized complex increments, shape 64x576; no background replication
coordinates.truth: Actual complex material, accepted only by explicit OFFLINE fit function
coordinates.background: Known actual complex material, scalar or 576
coordinates.actual_decoder: background + amplitude_scale * normalized_delta; amplitude_scale defaults to 1 and parent run sets 1.2
coordinates.fixed_W: positive diagonal cell weights, default 1/576 per pixel, repeated once for real and imaginary coordinates

start_rule.common_sources: start 0 is N3; starts 1..7 are the first seven TRAIN parents sorted by W distance from N3, with parent-index tie break
start_rule.selection: All TRAIN template/topology and sparse support choices fixed without truth by freeze_case before OFFLINE optimization
start_rule.trajectories: Store initial and each accepted iterate parameters/objective, best feasible value, optimizer status/reason and evaluation counts
start_rule.geometry: Each source chooses its nearest eligible TRAIN template using W distance; initialization is zero geometry plus independent regional complex contrasts least-squares fitted to that source
start_rule.sparse: For each source choose exactly budget largest absolute W-Haar real-coordinate coefficients, including independent imaginary coefficients; freeze support before fitting
start_rule.single_chart: One common TRAIN SVD basis, eight projected source initializations; no truth-selected basis or discrete chart

atlas.discrete_index: TRAIN support digital topology: 4-connected foreground, 8-connected background, components/holes/Euler; phase adjacency is also recorded; no dataset family labels
atlas.support_mask: abs(TRAIN normalized delta) >= 0.25 * per-parent max magnitude
atlas.phases: Up to three nonempty deterministic TRAIN magnitude-quantile bands inside occupancy; tied bands collapse. A phase may have multiple connected pieces, disclosed in metadata. Each retained phase has its own independent real and imaginary contrast.
atlas.geometry: TRAIN signed-distance fields shifted by partition-of-unity Gaussian normal-displacement controls anchored at distinct digital boundary points; nearest-boundary projection is frozen from TRAIN. These are allowed normal-boundary coefficients, not claimed B-splines.
atlas.geometry_bound: Every control lies in [-2,2] pixel units; positive partition-of-unity fields bound displacement by 2 pixels per phase
atlas.parameter_count: Exactly budget = (budget - 2*phase_count) free real geometry controls + 2*phase_count free real contrast values; templates unable to provide that independent basis are flagged ineligible, never padded
atlas.rasterization: Differentiable softmax partition with background logit zero and phase signed-distance logits / 0.5 pixel. Explicit mixture rule sums phase occupancies to <=1.
atlas.topology: Primary image is the best exact-box-feasible iterate preserving TRAIN digital support components/holes, per-phase components/holes, and phase adjacency. Topology-changing trajectories are retained as OFFLINE diagnostics, never accepted as atlas primary. The fixed 0.5-pixel rasterization is audited at zero geometry; smoothing-induced topology change makes that start ineligible. This is a digital predicate, not continuous topology/reach certification.
atlas.bias: Separately report TRAIN phase-quantization loss and soft-rasterization loss at zero geometry, plus achieved image versus hard partition discrepancy
atlas.topology_predicate: Support is sum(softmax phase occupancies)>=0.5; occupied cells are assigned to highest-occupancy phase with deterministic tie break. Compare 4-foreground/8-background signatures and phase adjacency to original TRAIN partition, independent of truth thresholds.

level_set.phases: Identical TRAIN-only phase partition and independent contrasts as atlas
level_set.geometry: Signed-distance perturbations by low-frequency real 2D DCT modes ordered by squared frequency, allocated across phases by boundary size
level_set.geometry_bound: Each of g controls is bounded by +/-3/g pixels after each basis field is normalized to sup-norm <=1; total displacement <=3 pixels per phase
level_set.parameter_count: Exactly budget = g + 2*phase_count real coordinates; numerical basis/tangent rank reported, deficient charts ineligible
level_set.rasterization: Same fixed 0.5-pixel softmax partition and explicit mixture rule as atlas
level_set.topology: Topology can change; record changes without a topology-preserving claim
level_set.bias: Report phase-quantization and soft-rasterization discrepancies separately

sparse.basis: W-orthogonal separable 2D Haar transform on 24x24: dyadic block decomposition 24->12->6->3, then fixed orthonormal 3x3 DCT coarse transform; no padding to 32
sparse.parameter_count: Exactly budget selected real coefficients across 576 real and 576 imaginary coordinates
sparse.actual_fit: Convex quadratic least-squares in each N3/TRAIN-frozen support under linear actual-material box constraints; no post-fit material clipping
sparse.certificate: Report primal feasibility, stationarity/dual/complementarity residuals and a feasible Frank-Wolfe linear-oracle gap when available; floating numerical certificates only, fail label if not certified
sparse.offline_tail: Separately calculate exact unconstrained orthogonal best-budget-term coefficient tail from truth-background and truth-selected support, explicitly OFFLINE; never feed it into actual supports or candidate initialization
sparse.interpretation: Best-term tail and actual fixed-support constrained QP are different classes; report their gap

single_chart.basis: Uncentered SVD of 64 independent TRAIN normalized increments in 1152 fixed-W real coordinates
single_chart.parameter_count: Use first budget real singular directions; budget 64 requires numerical rank 64; never center then silently pad rank 63
single_chart.actual_fit: Convex constrained affine QP under exact actual-material box, no image clipping
single_chart.certificate: Same primal/KKT/FW numerical checks as sparse

actual_material_bounds.geometry_contrasts: Conservative common regional contrast box from background extrema and amplitude_scale guarantees every regional endpoint and mixture obey actual material bounds. Report this stronger restriction explicitly.
actual_material_bounds.floating_boundary_policy: Any inward-nextafter parameter safeguard is recorded as ULP rounding protection, not a hidden feasibility tolerance. Actual image feasibility is checked with exact comparisons; infeasible iterations cannot be the reported image.
actual_material_bounds.affine_repair: If a numerically returned parameter violates exact box by rounding, contract along its coefficient ray toward feasible zero-delta/background; retain same basis/support and record contraction. Never clip material pixels.

output_contract.prepare_train: Frozen model with read-only TRAIN arrays, basis/phase metadata, rank/eligibility, and exact-budget checks; accepts no development truth
output_contract.freeze_case: Truth-free frozen sources, templates/supports and initial parameters
output_contract.fit_capacity: OFFLINE result with image/delta/params, all trajectories, exact dimensions, strict box feasibility, optimizer and global-versus-local labels, independent capacity loss fields, morphology supplied only by parent
output_contract.global_labels: Geometry: ACHIEVED_LOCAL_NONCONVEX_UPPER_BOUND; atlas additionally requires the frozen digital topology predicate. Affine: CONVEX_FIXED_CHART_NUMERICAL_CERTIFIED only when numerical certificate passes; discrete chart/support union is finite achieved fit, not unrestricted global capacity.
output_contract.no_online_truth: No target-based function is usable for online chart/support selection or candidate generation

verification: Synthetic unittest only using existing A25 .venv_a25 numpy/scipy; no development scoring, solver calls, package installs or locked payload access
